items.title: Vercel Security Review no longer requires a linked Vercel project
items.summary: You can now scan code changes for vulnerabilities with  in GitHub repositories that have not yet been linked to a Vercel project.Vercel Security ReviewBy default, Security Review covers all unlinked repositories the Vercel GitHub App can access in a connected GitHub account. You can limit coverage to selected connected accounts or individual repositories in Agent settings. Once enabled, each push to a covered repository automatically triggers a review of its code changes.Security Review checks commits directly in repositories with Security Review enabled, without requiring a Vercel project or deployment. When a push creates a deployment for a linked project with Security Review enabled, the review uses the additional project and deployment context.Connect the account in your team’s , then enable Security Review in .Git settingsVercel Agent settingsGet started with the .Security Review documentationRead more
